summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload with a cover-story filename
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNNNN identifiers and string-array dispatcher) and, on npm install, downloads a pinned Bun binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmod+x's it, and invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js at the package root. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscated blob (shuffled string-array rotator over an opaque hex-and-string constant table, no source map, no exports), and its filename bears no relation to the package's stated MCP-tools purpose. The result is that installing the package causes an alien runtime not otherwise present on the installer's machine to execute a large opaque payload at install time, bypassing Node-scoped tooling and sandboxes. The behavior of the payload itself is not observable without executing it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
